parameters.query:
SELECT
    pa.id      AS alert_id,
    pa.passenger_id,
    p.full_name,
    p.email,
    pa.origin,
    pa.destination,
    pa.seat_class,
    pa.threshold_price,
    pa.last_alerted_price,
    f.id       AS flight_id,
    f.flight_number,
    f.departure_ts,
    sc.base_price AS current_price,
    sc.currency
FROM price_alerts pa
JOIN passengers p   ON p.id = pa.passenger_id
JOIN flights f      ON f.origin = pa.origin
                   AND f.destination = pa.destination
                   AND f.status = 'scheduled'
                   AND f.departure_ts > now()
JOIN seat_classes sc ON sc.flight_id = f.id
                    AND sc.class = pa.seat_class
                    AND sc.available_seats > 0
WHERE pa.active = true
  AND sc.base_price <= pa.threshold_price
  AND (
        pa.last_alerted_price IS NULL
        OR sc.base_price < pa.last_alerted_price * 0.95
      );

parameters.subject: =Price drop: {{ $json.origin }} → {{ $json.destination }} now {{ $json.current_price }} {{ $json.currency }}
parameters.message:
=Good news {{ $json.full_name }}! Flight {{ $json.flight_number }} ({{ $json.seat_class }}) is now {{ $json.current_price }} {{ $json.currency }} — below your target of {{ $json.threshold_price }}. Departs: {{ $json.departure_ts
}}

parameters.query:
UPDATE price_alerts
SET last_alerted_price = {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.current_price }},
    last_alerted_at = now()
WHERE id = {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.alert_id }};
